completedQuestion.question: How does the current per-vertex safety clamp change displacement distribution and periodic-domain error in PR #79 head?
completedQuestion.answer: It preserves topology but clips 77.68% of active vertices and 74.34% of active area, retains only 23.43% of magnitude and 3.75% of squared energy, reverses the area-weighted signed mean, and masks rather than closes most periodic defects.
